title: Fix swatch/border animation desync on preset swatch hover
description:
On preset color/gradient and photo swatches in the Background settings panel, hovering/selecting causes the swatch's own hover transition and its border/outline to animate on different timing — they visibly don't move together. The custom/uploaded photo slot already animates swatch + border together correctly — use it as the reference implementation.

Compare the custom-photo hover/selected-border transition (correct) against the preset swatch (`.settings-bg-preset`) hover/selected-border transition and align their transition duration/easing/property so both animate as one cohesive state change, matching the custom slot's behavior.

Relevant files: components/SettingsPanel.js (swatch/overlay markup), meridian.css (preset/custom swatch + border transition rules, near the hover-remove overlay block ~line 2003-2037), mirrored in meridian-extension/. Verify visually that the fix doesn't regress the already-correct custom-photo hover.

Note: do NOT change the hover overlay darkening color/color-mix — that's out of scope for this task.
label: Bug

activity.content:
Implemented the preset swatch hover/outline synchronization fix.

- Moved the preset selected state to `.settings-bg-preset`, so the wrapper owns both the outline and hover transform.
- Matched the custom-photo transition properties, duration, and easing for `box-shadow` and `transform`.
- Kept source and packaged extension copies synchronized.
- Added regression assertions for selected-state placement and the shared transition contract.
- Left the hover overlay darkening color unchanged.

Validation:
- `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 137/137 passing.
- Headless Chromium computed-style check — preset and custom tiles both use `box-shadow, transform`, `0.15s`, `ease`, and reach the same `scale(1.05)` hover geometry.
- `git diff --check` and packaged parity checks pass.

Still broken — reopening. Screenshots attached (image-10 = custom photo, correct; image-11 = preset color swatch, still wrong).

Custom photo (correct): a single clean green ring hugs the image tightly and evenly on all 4 sides, no doubling.

Preset color swatch (still wrong): there appear to be TWO overlapping rings that are NOT concentric — a gold/amber selection ring visible on the top and left edges, and a separate darker ring/shadow visible on the bottom and right edges, offset down-and-right from the gold ring. It looks like the swatch content is scaling (transform: scale(...)) from a different transform-origin or on a different element than whatever draws the border/box-shadow, so under hover/selected state the swatch content and its border ring drift apart instead of moving together as one rigid box — the swatch overshoots past the border on the bottom-right while the border stays anchored differently.

This is NOT fixed by matching transition duration/easing alone (which is what the last pass did) — the actual box geometry (what scales, what transform-origin, which element owns the border vs which element owns the scale) still doesn't match the custom-photo implementation. Please diff the actual DOM structure + CSS box model between `.settings-bg-custom` (correct, single element or properly nested scale+border) and `.settings-bg-preset` (broken) — not just the transition timing values — and make the preset swatch use the same box structure so the border and content are always concentric/rigid together, exactly like custom. Attach a fresh screenshot after the fix showing the preset swatch hover state next to a working custom photo hover state for comparison.

Implemented the preset swatch geometry fix.

- Removed the redundant full-size child swatch from preset tiles. The preset wrapper now directly owns the background/image, clipping, hover transform, transition, and selected ring—the same single-box structure used by the custom-photo tile.
- Preserved mouse and keyboard activation, and stopped the selected remove control from bubbling into preset selection.
- Mirrored the implementation and CSS in `meridian-extension/`.
- Left the hover overlay darkening color unchanged.
- Expanded regression coverage to pin the single-box DOM structure, keyboard behavior, remove-event isolation, and shared transition contract.

Verification:

- `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 145/145 passing.
- Source/package component and stylesheet parity checks pass.
- `git diff --check` passes.
- Headed Chromium computed-style check: custom and preset both reach `scale(1.05)` from the same centered transform origin, use `box-shadow, transform` at `0.15s` / `ease`, and render one 2 px selection ring on the transformed visual element.

Fresh hover comparison (custom photo reference left; fixed preset color right):
